notes: Federal budget rules applied to every SBIR/STTR budget. Amounts are dollars and rates are percentages, both written as strings so they parse as exact decimals rather than floats. These are published figures that change on a schedule — the salary cap and the award guidelines are revised annually — so they live here and the version is stamped onto every budget produced.

salary_cap.authority: Executive Level II of the Federal Executive Pay Schedule

fringe.authority: Organization's own rate; 30% is a placeholder for planning only

indirect.authority: 2 CFR 200.414 and 2 CFR 200 Appendix III (MTDC base)

fee.authority: SBIR/STTR Policy Directive, profit/fee on total direct and indirect costs
